info.name: Atelier Health - backend-demo
info.description:
All microservice routes merged into one demo backend.

Run top-to-bottom inside each folder. Tokens and IDs are captured automatically into collection variables by test scripts.

Demo quirks:
- SMS/WhatsApp print to console until TWILIO_* env vars are set.
- OTP devCode is returned because DEMO_EXPOSE_OTP=true.
- Payments use a mock-capture endpoint (no Razorpay keys).
- Dispensing consumes real stock rows; re-running the whole collection twice needs `data/` wiped or a new walk-in.

item.name: Token live stream (SSE)
item.description: text/event-stream. Emits `snapshot` then `update` events on queue/consultation topics; heartbeat every 20s. Postman shows raw SSE chunks.

item.name: Join waitlist
item.description: Patient joins the doctor's waitlist (409 if already WAITING/OFFERED). Cancelling one of the doctor's appointments auto-offers the slot to the oldest WAITING entry.

item.name: Leave waitlist
item.description: Marks the entry LEFT. Runs last so the folder can be repeated cleanly.
